response.text: The table name is case-sensitive; I'll quote it as "SYSDICT". I'll also check the sign convention and the date encoding, and see how the journal and AP tables connect.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID", h."MEMO", SUM(l."DR_AMT") dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") cr, COUNT(*) lines FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT MIN("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='AP') OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT MIN("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6;
